implementation: Flutter own-profile edits now preserve display-name input exactly and enforce the same 1–64 Unicode code-point rule as web/backend. Password change enforces 12–128 code points for both current and new passwords. The profile heading is a semantic header and receives keyboard focus when the screen opens; mutation and logout status/error copy is exposed as a live region.

checks.name: Profile mutation contract and widget focus/accessibility tests
checks.observation: Covered exact whitespace-preserving display-name submission, supplementary-plane Unicode boundaries, current/new password maximum, no grapheme-count UI cap, semantic heading focus and live mutation error announcements.

checks.name: macOS release compile
checks.observation: Release app built successfully (83.1 MB); local ad-hoc build is not signed for distribution.

checks.name: Android signed release compile
checks.observation: Release APK built and APK Signature Scheme v2 verified; POST_NOTIFICATIONS and foreground MediaProjection permissions are present.

remaining: Physical keyboard and screen-reader acceptance, Samsung/Gboard first-character entry, and matched visual screenshots remain open in the parity checklist.
